question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 8.**
solution:
The correct answer is: who

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given Wh-words. 
 
 
• Which is used in questions as a determiner and interrogative pronoun to ask for specific information.
 
• Whom should be used to refer to the object of a verb or preposition. 
 
• Who should be used to refer to the subject of a sentence.
 
• Whose is used when you're asking (or telling) to whom something belongs.
 
 
 
• As per the usage of the given Wh-words "who" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it refers to the subject **Mr. Miller.**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 3.

Complete Paragraph: *In 1945, James Leach Miller returned from World War II and shared nothing (1) about__ it with his wife. He folded up his Army (__2) uniform__, with the medals still pinned to it, and __(3) carefully__ put it in the basement, where his older boy would __(4) sometimes__ take it out to play soldiers. He never complained __(5) because__ that generation of army men didn’t air their problems. His son Michael once offered to take him back to Normandy when World War II veterans __(6) were making__ the journey but his father shook __(7) his__ head saying, “I’ve been there once.” Sadly, Mr. Miller, 96 years old, **__(8) who __**survived the bloodiest battle of World War II, died of (9)______ from the coronavirus on March 30 (10)______ an Old Soldiers’ Home.*
